The Company recently hired Kate Zibell as Chief Marketing Officer, a force in modern marketing known for building high-performing teams and driving growth across global consumer brands, including direct-to-consumer strategies. Zibells hire represents a pivotal step in repositioning Turtle Beach(r) as a cultural challenger brand at the intersection of gaming, lifestyle, and entertainment.
